chapters.title: Chapter 628: Thousands of souls
paragraphs: "Oh my god, it's a quasi elixir!"
"I feel the power of the strong rules above!"
"I have been in the Quasi-Sage Realm for 20,000 years! I have not taken this elixir, but I feel that my bottleneck has begun to loosen!"
"Master Su is so in love with me, I'm torn to pieces, I can't help it!"
"I wish to follow Young Master Su forever!"
Thousands of warriors were no longer silent, and they all talked a lot, and then bowed down to Su Lang!
For this scene, Yao Chi Yan Fa and other sixteen martial sages all expressed emotion.
How much did they pay to break through to the realm of Martial Saint?
But at this time, these younger generations are really lucky to be able to break through Martial Saint so easily.
"Hmph, if these people dare to be unfaithful at all, I will definitely impeach them!"
The martial arts looked at each other, and they all saw the resolute color in each other's eyes.
"Okay, time is running out, don't worship."
Su Lang waved his hand and said, "You hand over the fire of your soul, and I will immediately take you to a mysterious cultivation treasure!"
Before the words fell, everyone shut up, and the hall was so quiet that a hair drop could be heard.
Immediately, everyone began to force their souls.
And one by one, the speed is very fast. It seems that I am afraid that I am slow and be overtaken by others.
A short while.
Tens of thousands of golden lights appeared in the hall, these are soul fire!
"So many souls are angry..."
Su Lang asked Li Xianyang Voice Transmission, "Is there any problem with taking all of them into the Sea of Knowledge?"
"Return to the Lord."
"If there is no special secret method, collecting so many souls will inevitably lead to confusion and even annihilation!"
Li Xianyang replied respectfully, "But the servant has a secret method called "Secret of Soul Seed Heart", which can solve all related problems.
Besides, it is also possible not to store the soul fire in the sea of consciousness, but to place it in the sacred vessel. "
"The Secret of Soul Seed Heart"?"
Su Lang nodded, and found Li Xianyang's "Secret of Soul Seed Heart" from the storage space.
"Huh? It's a holy rank technique, it's a bit difficult to handle."
"It takes one or two days for me to practice the god-level exercises now. Isn't it ten or twenty days for the holy-level exercises?
Su Lang frowned slightly, Xuan even prepared to use the second method to pin everyone's souls in the sacred vessel.
This method is recorded in "The Secret of Soul Seed Heart", but it saves Su Lang from asking Li Xianyang again.
"The sacred artifacts to be entrusted are preferably spiritual ones that can nurture spirits..."
Su Lang looked at "The Secret of Soul Seed Heart", suddenly his eyes lit up.
He happened to have one holy artifact that could nurture the soul.
At that time, when Wuyang Wusheng was beheaded, Su Lang got an intermediate holy artifact, named Yinhun Xuanyu Banner.
This holy artifact has been under the bottom of the box for a long time, and Su Lang almost forgot.
The Yinhun Xuanyu Banner was originally a sacred tool used by Wuyang Wusheng to nourish the Yinhun.
It is very evil and cruel when collecting souls from others, but this sacred artifact itself is a treasure that can nurture the soul.
Even the holder can use it to subtly enhance their own spirits.
"It was originally planned to be broken down, but now it seems that you are still useful."
Su Lang smiled faintly, and immediately waved his big hand, and the hearts of thousands of souls below immediately floated upwards like fireflies.
All the soul fire soon fell into Su Lang's hands.
Immediately afterwards, Su Lang took out the Dark Soul Xuanyu Banner, and sealed these souls in with secret methods.
Suddenly, there was a faint emotion in the ghost Xuanyao Banner.
Su Lang could feel strong emotions of gratitude, excitement, excitement, and anticipation.
"I can also judge whether they have betrayed by the fire of their souls."
"The soul fire here is extinguished by me, and they will also die instantly."
"Their lives are already in my hands."
Su Lang smiled, and accepted the ghost Xuanyu Banner.

Once someone breaks through to Wu Sheng, it will cause a huge sensation.
If Wu Sheng appeared one after another, it was likely to cause panic and disrupt the order on the Blue Star.
After Su Lang spoke, those warriors who had begun to comprehend the rules only received a little regret.
Then, under the leadership of Su Lang, tens of thousands of people came to a remote sea island.
There is the sea around here, no one comes at all, it is not easy to be disturbed, and when the martial artist breaks through the martial arts, it is not easy to cause a sensation on the blue star.
"Everyone is practicing here."
"I hope you can break through the martial arts realm as soon as possible, I need your help.
As Su Lang said, he looked at Yanxingxing, "You and Huangfuqin are also practicing here, by the way, manage these personnel.
The job of guarding the cracks in time and space is temporarily handed to me, just as I want to reform the formation.
It was Su Lang's plan to transform the guardian formation of the two clans and the cracks in time and space, but something was delayed.
When I come back, I will do it.
"Yes, patriarch!"
Yan Hengxing and Huangfuqin bowed.
Su Lang took out some holy grade pills and quasi-elixir pills to them, and went to the time and space cracks alone.
Next.
Under the arrangement of Yanxingxing and Huangfuqin, the three tribal gods and quasi-sages began to practice and comprehend the rules.
From time to time, someone took out a quasi elixir and cautiously took it into the belly.
On the top of the island mountain, Chu Xiaobei and Ji Ruxue Murong Slim sat facing each other and took out an elixir.
This elixir is the immortal soul pill, the elixir of three tribulations.
"Is this the elixir?"
"Gave me a strange feeling!"
"Well, I think I have to stay away, or it will be dangerous."
Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian looked at the pill in Chu Xiaobei's hand, and couldn't help feeling dizzy and confused, and immediately raised their vigilance.
"This pill is indeed too dangerous for you, even the smell is not smellable!"
Chu Xiaobei smiled and said, "You go and play, I want to practice, and strive to break through to the Eight-Star Martial Saint as soon as possible."
"We don't want to play."
"Sister Xiaobei, let's go to the sky to watch you, can we protect you?"
Ji Ruxue turned her smart eyes, and Murong Xianxian nodded heavily.

chapters.title: Chapter 632: Cangkong Phantom United Fairy Array
paragraphs: "Okay!"
Chu Xiaobei smiled and nodded, "But you have to be farther apart!"
"There will be no problems with the flying treasures that Brother Su Lang has refined for us."
Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian smiled and flew high into the sky.
Look down from the air.
Every certain distance on the entire island, there is a quasi-sage or peak warrior or cross-legged meditation, or eyes closed, or taking pills, or whispering.
Because the warriors understand the rules, a trace of anomaly appears on the island from time to time, which is quite strange!
"We will also understand the rules in the future and become a martial artist!"
"Well, at least you have to become a martial artist to be useful to Brother Su. I don't want to be a vase."
Although it was difficult, Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian made up their minds to become Su Lang's good helpers.
The other side.
Su Lang had already come to the crack of time and space of Blue Star.
Strictly speaking, it didn't take long for the formations here to be deployed, but they could no longer keep up with Su Lang's pace, and could no longer protect Blue Star's safety.
"Liutianlou is so powerful that you have to deploy a fairy-level formation."
Su Lang thought while checking the formations he had mastered.
The formations currently mastered are all holy steps, coming from Li Xianyang and the holy land of the holy cities.
"I remember that Li Xianyang had burned some Array Dao classics, look for it."
Su Lang took out all the classics engraved by Li Xianyang and began to search through ten lines.
Soon, he found the Zhendao classics.
This is a sacred formation, but it records a comprehensive formation of immortality for the first time.

This formation is called the Cangkong Phantom Immortal Formation, and it is equipped with defense, counterattack, illusion and mental defense. Although the level is only a catastrophe immortal level, it is really good.
"It's you!"
Su Lang clicked the corner of his mouth and began to study the layout of this formation.
Not long after, this formation was completely mastered by him.
"Next, it's time to synthesize the fairy-level materials needed for the formation."
"Although this formation is a fairy rank, most of the materials are holy ranks. It's really a friendly formation."
With a happy mood, Su Lang quickly synthesized the required materials, and used the one-key refining function to refine the sky phantom fairy array.
A pink piece the size of a millstone appeared in Su Lang's hands.
Engraved with dense arrays of texts, it makes people dizzy at first glance.
This is the formation of Cangkong Phantom Immortal Formation.
However, after refining the formation plate, Su Lang did not end there, but began to refine more sky magical fairy formations and holy rank formations.
His purpose is to use multiple immortal formations and holy formations to form a combined formation to improve the various abilities of the formation.
Even with the help of a key refining array, this process took Su Lang a lot of time.
Fortunately, what Su Lang worried about did not happen
——Lantian Tower hasn't appeared in the holy city, at least it hasn't appeared on the surface.
At this moment.
Su Lang had already refined the first immortal rank united formation, possessing the power of the two tribulation martial immortal rank.
Although it seems that it has only improved a small level, the power of the increase is very scary.
The higher the realm, the greater the gap between the smaller realms.
At the level of Wuxian, a small gap is like a chasm!
That is to say, Su Lang's Array Dao attainments are extraordinary, and only then can he use the One Tribulation Immortal Array and the Holy Step Array to lay out the Second-Order Immortal Array.
It was impossible to do so with any immortal formation mage.
"This formation has the power of the Second Tribulation Martial Immortal rank, and it has the ability to explode!"
"Once the defense is insufficient, it will explode and destroy, and die with the enemy!"

"Not only that, the time of self-destruction can also destroy time and space cracks, causing time and space turbulence, making people unable to pass through time and space cracks in a short time, um, yes!"
Su Lang was very satisfied with his work, and with a big wave of his hand, he began to set up this joint two-tribulation immortal formation.
Because it is based on the array plate, the layout is quickly completed.
Su Lang took out one million middle-grade spirit jade from the system and embedded it in the formation as energy.
No way, the concentration of aura on the blue star is still too low to support the operation of the immortal formation.
After releasing the energy, Su Lang cancelled and decomposed the originally arranged holy step formation, restored it to materials, and then activated the new formation.

chapters.title: Chapter 633: Become a construction mad
paragraphs: "Cangkong phantoms unite the immortal formation, come!"
Su Lang pinched the tactics with both hands and activated the United Immortal Formation.
Suddenly, a layer of pink mask stretched out from the main array and gradually swallowed the sky.
After a while, the entire sky turned a faint pink!
"I don't know who created the sky phantom fairy array. It turned out to be pink. It's really a show bag."
Su Lang rolled his eyes silently, and immediately activated the Array Magic function, transforming a blue sky and white clouds.
"Here is finished, and there is still Canglan Continent."
"The formation of the sea of sky can be upgraded."
"Chiri Holy City, Chiri Mountain, Tianyun Holy City, and Tianyun Holy Realm must also be deployed."
"Hi, I feel like a construction madman."
While grumbling, Su Lang opened the time-space crack and came to the entrance of the time-space crack in Canglan Continent.
Using the same method, Su Lang arranged a second azure phantom united immortal formation to protect the entrance to the crack in time and space.
By the way, the newly built city was also protected.

As for the main city of the Wind Spirit tribe, Su Lang found that everyone was gathering here, and the main city of the Wind Spirit tribe was likely to become a secondary city, so he didn't bother to change the formation.

Immediately, through the dispatch of clones and substitution of clones, he arranged the Cangkong Phantom Alliance Immortal Array in the four places of Chiri Holy City, Chiri Mountain, Tianyun Holy City, and Tianyun Holy Realm.
Compared to the Blue Star, the three sky phantoms of the Canglan Continent combined with the immortal array Su Lang Duzhi and left one hundred thousand high-grade spirit jade.
Because the aura of the Canglan Continent is very strong, especially the holy city and holy land, there is no need for too much spiritual jade.
Of course, as for energy, the more sufficient the better.
After finishing the formation, Su Lang immediately notified the patriarchs of the two clans, Chirimuzhu and Tianyunzhi.
"what!?"
"The Lord has arranged a fairy-step formation for our holy city and holy land!"
"It's great, great, the safety of our lair is guaranteed with the fairy-step formation!
"The Lord is so kind to us!"
"Thank the Lord so much!"
The martial sages of the Chiri Saint Clan and the Tianyun Saint Clan were grateful.
At this time.
Su Lang's figure appeared above the sea of sky.
"The Lord is back!"
"The Lord has such a magical means of teleportation, it's really unheard of!"
"Can you guess the miracle of the Lord!?"
In the sea of sky, the martial gods looked at Su Lang excitedly.
And Su Lang was looking down at the sea of sky.
Originally, the sea of sky was refined for the saints of Yaochi.
But now the Yaochi saints have become Su Lang's assets, and of course the sea of sky is back in his hands.
"The sea of sky is one of my reliance against the Slaughter Tower."
"So not only must the formation be upgraded, but it must also be strengthened."
While thinking, Su Lang flew to the top of the sea of sky.
"Yan Fa, let everyone come out."
Su Lang's faint voice spread into the sea of sky.
"Yes, Lord!
Yan Fa took the order, and immediately the sixteen martial sages and all the warriors evacuated from the sea of sky.
"These are the formation keys of Cangkong Phantom and Immortal Array, you keep them."
Su Lang threw a lot of keys and jade slips (instructions) to Chiri Muzhu and Tian Yunzhi.
"Thank the Lord for the generous gift!"
The patriarchs of the two clans knelt down and thanked them for a long time.
That's a fairy formation, a real fairy formation!
"All get up."
Su Lang smiled faintly.
Chiri Muzhu and Tianyunzhi took their orders and immediately stood aside and watched.
Yaochi Yan Fa and the others are not enthusiastic.
Because they knew that the reason why Su Lang asked them to evacuate from the sea of sky was definitely not aimless. Most of them wanted to reform their formation.
At this time.
Without the auspices of the martial gods and martial sages, the power of the sky sea gradually declined by more than half.
Outside the holy city of Yaochi.
A warrior looked up at the sky and discovered the anomaly of the sea of sky.
This martial artist looks ordinary, but he is a member of the Slaughter Tower, with a cultivation base of six-star martial sage!
"The power of this quasi-immortal weapon suddenly dropped!"
"Unfortunately, the formation barrier still exists. At the moment, the city is under martial law and no one can enter or leave. I still can't get in."
"But the changes here can be reported to the adults, and maybe the adults can see something."
Thinking about it, Liutianlou Six-Star Martial Saint took out the jade card of transmission and prepared to send the message.
But at this moment, an accident happened suddenly.

chapters.title: Chapter 634: Zhu 108
paragraphs: I saw that the indigo light mask covering a large area disappeared instantly.
In the sky, the scene like an ocean disappeared.
"This is... the quasi-immortal weapon has been put away!?"
The Six-Star Martial Saint was surprised, and immediately used the technique, intending to sneak into the city.
But when he left, he hesitated again.
"Cai Liao is dead here, and it's probably a martial immortal who killed him!"
"If I sneak in, I can't hide from Wuxian's search, and my life will be in danger."
"And the quasi-immortal weapon was put away, it is probably a trap!"
The six-star Martial Saint of Luntianlou was more frightened as he thought about it, and in the end he even sweated.
"Fortunately, I am not so impulsive!"
"The most urgent thing is to send a message, and then leave this place."
Liutianlou Six-Star Martial Saint took a deep breath, even if he wanted to leave.
But at this moment.
A joking voice suddenly sounded in his ear: "Since it's here, let's save your life."
"what!?"
The six-star Martial Saint of Luntianlou instantly turned pale, his hair standing upside down.
He was found! !
escape! !
Without even thinking about it, the Six-Star Martial Saint of Tuantian Tower immediately turned into Streamer and fled towards the distance.
But as soon as he moved, he felt a terrifying mental attack falling on him.
"boom!!"
In the sea of consciousness, there was a violent silent explosion, and the six-star Martial Saint of Liutianlou darkened his eyes and died immediately.

"Ding! You get the Soul of the Intermediate Martial Saint*1, the Enlightenment of Space*1, the Seven-Color Nail of the Elementary Saint Soldier Flying Star*1, the Supreme Spirit Jade*5230, the High Grade Spirit Jade*220682, the Middle Grade Spirit Jade*3250684, the Lower Grade Spirit Jade*25653686, material for holy refiner..."
A system reminder appeared in Su Lang's mind.
"Ok?"
When Su Lang's expression moved, he saw Li Xianyang flying from a distance.
"Master Xianyang!"
"It's Master Xianyang here!"
Yaochi Yan Fa and others looked in awe.
In their eyes, Li Xianyang was not only a strong man who could kill the immortal in seconds, but also the highest-ranking servant around Su Lang, and he was regarded as their chief manager.
"It turns out that Li Xianyang killed it." Su Lang smiled faintly.
"Master!"
Li Xianyang saluted, "Just now, I sensed that there was a wave of Saint-level cultivation techniques outside the city, and immediately I found a sage martial artist sneaking up and killed him."
"well done!"
"Appearing nearby at this time, it is likely to be the people from Tutianlou."
Su Lang rummaged through the storage space and took out some things.
Among them is a red token with the character'Zhu' engraved on the front and 108 on the back.
"This token, Cai Liao also has a similar one."
Su Lang said, "However, the sculpture is not Zhu, but Sheng, and the serial number is even higher."
"It seems that this person is the spy of the Slaughter Tower!
Li Xianyang looked solemn, "They are already eyeing us!"
As soon as he said this, Yaochi Yan Fa and others also showed nervousness.
"do not worry."
Su Lang smiled faintly, "I will transform the sea of the sky. Even if the real martial immortal comes, it will be difficult to break the defense."
"Master...I want to transform the sea of sky!?"
Li Xianyang looked surprised, "The sea of the sky is a quasi-immortal weapon, is it to be promoted to a fairy-tool?"
"Not bad!"
Su Lang hooked the corner of his mouth.
"what!?"
"The Lord wants to promote the sea of the sky to an immortal weapon!"
"Fairy tools, even in the fairy clan, they are precious treasures!"
"We are blessed by the Lord, we really have accumulated hundreds of lifetime virtues!"
"Yeah yeah!"
Yaochi Yan Fa and others are going crazy!
At this time, Su Lang stretched out his hand, and the sea of sky shrank to the size of a palm.
Those buildings that depended on the sky and sea fell down, and Yaochi Yan Fa and others quickly supported them.
Immediately, Su Lang collected the sea of sky into the storage space.
"It's about to begin, the evolution of the sea of sky!"
Su Lang's eyes lit up slightly, and he gave instructions to the system.

chapters.title: Chapter 635: Fairy sky sea
paragraphs: "System, evolve the sea of sky!"
Su Lang did not choose to retain certain characteristics of the Sky Sea, because that would require certain materials to be consumed.
For the sea of sky to evolve into a fairy tool, it needs to consume a lot of holy-level materials and immortal-level materials.
The immortal-level materials on Su Lang are all synthesized, if the consumption materials need to be specified, it is definitely not enough.
Therefore, it can only evolve randomly.
Anyway, no matter how it evolves, it is also a defensive auxiliary type fairy weapon, and this will not change.
"Ding! Consumption of fairy-level materials, Extreme Saint Xianliu*2, Arctic Wangchen Stone*1, Wuying Cuiyu Jade*1, Photographic Wuxiangquan*2...
Saint-level refining material: Soul of Wusheng*5, Xuanshizhenyan*20, Mingxin Sacred Jade*30, Heart of Stars and Moon*30, Shocking Amethyst*50..., the sky sea evolved into Elementary fairy! "

The light it emits is more and more dazzling, almost like the same day!
The bright golden light burst out, and the entire black sea of consciousness was opened up more bright space!
However, although the Sea of Consciousness that is currently being developed may seem vast, it actually only accounts for a very small part of the Sea of Consciousness.
The sea of knowledge is the most mysterious place of warriors, and almost no one can develop it to the end.
At this time.
The sphere of Jinghua's mental power ball has filled the entire sea of consciousness halo.
The surface of the psychic ball is covered with pits and pits, and a halo is set on its waist.
Overall, it looks like a strange moon with a planetary ring.
"Is this the realm of Huiyue!"
Su Lang felt the enormous spiritual power in the sea of knowledge, and his eyes sparkled with excitement.
The realm of Huiyue, the realm of spiritual power possessed by Wu Sheng, he also has!
"If I use the clone to swallow it, I don't know if I can reach the realm of the sun."
As Su Lang thought, he calmed down the turbulent spirit in the sea.
——I just broke through, "Huiyue" is still a bit unstable.
A short while.
The spiritual power has calmed down, and Su Lang's spiritual realm has been consolidated!
"System, accept the fire rules!"
Su Lang continued to give orders without any muddle.
"Ding!
Fire rules have been issued!"
Silently, an invisible and transparent flame seemed to rise around Su Lang.
This flame is ever-changing, and it seems that countless different kinds of flames can be transformed into.
This is the vision of comprehending the rules.
When Su Lang comprehended the rules of the Thunder System before, countless lasses appeared.
"Fire rules!"
Su Lang's eyes flickered, and he stretched out a hand, countless flames are coming and going, and they are unusually brilliant.
The highest power of these flames has reached the real martial arts level!
This made Su Lang very happy.
Soon, Su Lang discovered an interesting thing
——The fire rules he comprehend couldn't evolve three kinds of different fires: Qinglian Dragon Fire, Xuanyun Jingyue Fire, and Ziwei Wuding Fire!
"Can't evolve alien fire..."
"There is no strange fire on the Canglan Continent."
"It seems that the different fire is more mysterious than I thought."
"Perhaps, I can go back to the blue star and refine all those abnormal fires."
Su Lang thought about it, planning to refine those strange fires next time he returned to Blue Star.
He accompanied Chu Xiaobei's three daughters to almost the entire Blue Star before, and of course he saw a lot of strange fires.
But the different fire did not have any important effect on Su Lang, at least on the surface.
Therefore, Su Lang didn't think much about it, and didn't try to refine it.
I don't know what kind of strange results will be produced after refining those strange fires.
"Come!"
Su Lang accepted the rules of the fire system and asked, "System, how long will it take for my five god-level exercises to reach the founding level?"
"Ding!
Host, it takes 18 hours to cultivate to the founding level with the five god-level techniques!"

chapters.title: Chapter 639: Nine Star Sacred Sword, Youtian!
paragraphs: "18 more hours, close to a day?"
Su Lang raised his brows slightly, "It's so slow, one day, how long it is!"
I don't know if the other warriors heard Su Lang's complaint and couldn't help but rush up and desperately!
They practiced the god-level techniques to reach the Consummation level for 10,000 years...
"I haven't seen the property panel for a long time, looking forward to~"
With a thought, Su Lang opened his attribute panel.
[Name]: Su Lang
[Race]: human
[Qualification Level]: Turbidity
[Realm level]: Peak Wuzun
[Attack level]: One-star Wusheng
[Defensive Level]: Quasi-Saint+
[Shenfa level]: quasi-sage+
[Endurance Level]: Zhuansheng+
[Spirit Level]: Realm of Bright Moon

Shi Jue Lingxiao Profound Sword (Zun, founding), Haoran Lingtian Sword Jue (Zun, founding), Shui Ling Wu Jian Jue (Zun, founding), Drifting Shadowless Sword Technique (Zun, founding)

[Activated system functions]: One-key training function (level 22), one-key training function (level 21), clone dispatch function (level 20), one-key treasure hunting function (level 20), one-key alchemy function (level 14) ), one-key mixer function (level 14), one-key array function (level 14), one-key synthesis function (level 15), one-key decomposition function (no level)
"Oh~"
A hint of excitement appeared on Su Lang's face, "The attack level has finally reached the real martial sage level!"
From the quasi-sage to the real sacred order, there is an unknowingly large moat.
Even if Su Lang had practiced a lot of exercises and understood the rules of the Thunder System, it would be difficult for him to cross this gap.
Until today, once again comprehending the rules of the fire system, did the attack state cross the sky and reach the one-star martial sage state!
After some excitement, Su Lang calmed down and took out the Youtian Sword.
At this time, he had already put the resources of the three holy races into his bag, possessing a variety of treasured holy rank materials, and could also synthesize fairy rank materials.
Therefore, Su Lang intends to be promoted to Youtian Sword again.
Of course, he didn't know if the materials were enough, just a pure try.
"system!"
Su Lang ordered, "Only retain the current characteristics, evolve the Youtian Sword!"

"Ding! Host, to retain the characteristics and evolve the Youtian Sword, you need to use the holy refining material Tianyue holy soil*20, misty holy lotus petals*12, jade girl long hatred stone*12, drunken dream Tianze jade*12, Qing Huihuan Amethyst*12, Soul of Wusheng*2, Soul of Valkyrie*10..."
"Need so many materials, but also the soul of Martial Saint?"
Su Lang frowned slightly, and then began to search for the materials proposed by the system in the storage space.
The most cherished soul of Martial Saint is enough.
Su Lang slayed the two martial sages of Wuyang Demon Cave, and slayed Cai Liao and Zhu 108, and then obtained nine shares from the three clans secret library.
Counting the soul of Wusheng that has been used, there are currently seven remaining.
The Valkyrie Soul has more left, which is completely enough.
After some inventory, Su Lang discovered that the missing materials were the Jade Girl Changhen Stone and Drunken Dream Tianze Jade.
Fortunately, the number is insufficient.
Su Lang took out a lot of god-level materials and began to synthesize according to feelings.
After trying hundreds of times and synthesizing hundreds of holy grade materials, I finally synthesized the Jade Girl Changhen Stone and Drunken Dream Tianze Jade.
"This is enough material!"
Su Lang smiled, "System! Only retain the current characteristics, evolve the Heavenly Sword!"

"Ding! Consumption of holy refining material Tianyue holy soil*20, misty sacred lotus petals*12, jade girl of long hatred*12, drunken dream Tianze jade*12, Qinghui magic amethyst*12, Wusheng soul *2, the Soul of the Valkyrie*10...The Youtian Sword has evolved into a high-level saint!"
The Youtian Sword in Su Lang's hand flashed light, and the black pattern on the white background seemed to come alive, quite spiritual.
"Nine Star Sacred Sword!"
"It's only a little bit to reach the quasi-immortal level."
Su Lang swung the Youtian Sword lightly, and he felt that he could kill almost all the martial sages in the world with a sword in his hand.
In fact, although it is not so exaggerated, it is not far off.
There are really too few Martial Saints who can hold the Youtian Sword!

chapters.title: Chapter 640: Sure enough
paragraphs: Played the Youtian Sword.
Su Lang put it in the storage space and once again faced a multiple-choice question.
That is what rules should be understood by the following rules.
The basic rules of the five elements of heaven, earth, and earth, there are still four types of gold, wood, water, and soil that are not understood.
"Well."
"I don't have many exercises from the Metal System, the Wood System, and the Earth System, but it's the water system. There are exercises such as blowing snow without traces."
Su Lang thought, and suddenly the corner of his mouth twitched, "Moreover, I was originally called Lang. Only by comprehending a water system technique can I have a more pleasant wave!"
With a decision in his mind, Su Lang immediately issued an order: "System, let me understand the rules of the water system!"
"Ding! Start to comprehend the rules of the water system!"
At this point, in the mysterious black space, the whole body of the cultivating villain, the halo, and the halo have become white again.
But Su Lang knew that it would not take long for it to turn golden again.
No way, our cultivation speed is more than five million times that of ordinary talents!
Newly understood rules are selected.
Su Lang planned to return to Blue Star to take a look.
Coming out of the closed room, a dumpling suddenly appeared in front of Su Lang. It was the spirit of the sky sea, Xiao Hai.
It was still holding a face that looked like Su Lang, and Su Lang was speechless for a while.
"Ma Ma Ma Ma~"
Xiao Hai yelled and threw himself into Su Lang's arms.
"I'll go, don't call me numb, I will find one for you right away!"
Su Lang rolled his eyes fiercely, and immediately patted Xiaohai, "Go and play."
"Ma Ma Ma Ma~
Xiao Hai seemed to feel Su Lang's emotions, and made some grievances.
Su Lang could not laugh or cry, but was speechless.
In the end, he could only pat Xiaohai lightly to express comfort.
Xiao Hai was really coaxing too, so he didn't feel wronged, but he became more excited.
"Ma Ma Ma Ma!"
It called out loudly, making Su Lang feel as if he had made a serious mistake.
You shouldn't give you a little sweetness to this clingy little fairy.
"Ugh."
Su Lang held his forehead with his hand and sighed.
He really wanted to just leave like this.
But in this case, it's like a scumbag who doesn't care about children.
My Su Lang is so handsome, don't be a scumbag!
then what should we do.
Thinking...
He quickly thought of a way!
"My clone is exactly the same as me, I will call a clone to play with it."
Su Lang stretched his brows, and immediately sent a clone to his side.
"Chiji!?"
Xiao Hai looked at the two Ma Ma in front of him, and suddenly crashed.
"Hehe."
"Sure enough, silly and confused!
Su Lang showed complacency, and then immediately used his clone to replace him to Blue Star.
But after he replaced the clones, two clones were left in place, causing Xiao Hai to stay there stupidly, unable to tell who was the real and the fake.
It probably didn't think that the two in front of it were real.
At this time, Su Lang withdrew one clone, and immediately issued an order to the other clone: Bring me a child!
The clone with medium wits really started to execute the order and played with Xiaohai!
Mad, that's so cool!
It would be nice to have a clone when studying before.
You, learn math for me!
You, learn Chinese for me!
You, learn English for me!
Gee, think about it!
Closer to home.
Su Lang has arrived at the remote island of Blue Star.
As soon as he appeared above the small island, he discovered that there was a lot of martial sage-level aura between heaven and earth!
"One, two, three, four, five... Eighteen!"
"In such a short period of time, eighteen quasi-sages have broken through to the martial-sage level!"
A satisfied smile appeared on Su Lang's face.
So many martial sages appeared in a short period of time, which was very surprising, but in fact, it did not surprise Su Lang.
Think about it, how long have those quasi-sages stuck at the quasi-sage level?
Not to mention 10,000 years, there are old quasi-sages who have been holding back tens of thousands of years.
In fact, all aspects of their conditions have reached a breakthrough point, only one opportunity is left.
At this time, when I came to Blue Star, I was assisted by the quasi elixir, and of course I broke through all at once.

chapters.title: Chapter 641: You actually have a child outside
paragraphs: Just when Su Lang was happy.
There was another vast and terrifying vision between heaven and earth.
"Another Wu Xmas is born!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth hooked and smiled happily.
It is foreseeable that in just one day, hundreds of martial sages will appear!
With a happy mood, Su Lang flew down, and soon met Ruxue and Slim who were protecting Chu Xiaobei's law.
Of course, there is no danger at all on the Blue Star, so they just practiced on their own, and then watched the quasi-sages at their feet sanctified, and let out a cry of wonder.
Su Lang flew down, and the eyes of the two women naturally shifted to Su Lang.
"Brother Su Lang, you are back!"
"Brother Su Lang, many quasi saints have been sanctified!"
"They were so scary when they were sanctified. Fortunately, there are artifacts made by Brother Su Lang for us!"
Ruxue and Xianxian whispered around Su Lang.
Su Lang's expression moved, and he thought to himself: "These two girls are a bit close to Xiaohai's character. Now that Xiaobei is practicing, you can also ask them to bring Xiaohai."
Thinking of this, he made a decision.
Before Chu Xiaobei's retreat was over, let Ruxue and Xianxian go to take Xiaohai.
After Chu Xiaobei's retreat is over, let her take it.
"Ahem."
"Ruxue, Xianxian, I have something to tell you.
Su Lang coughed slightly and laughed, "I want to ask you to help me bring the children."
Ji Ruxue and Murong Slim were full of question marks, and at the same time, both small faces were shocked.
Immediately afterwards, the shocked two women's complexion gradually turned cold, and they said in unison: "Su Lang, you actually have a child outside!?"
Su Lang couldn't laugh or cry. After some explanation, the two women realized that the sea of sky had produced the spirit.
"Aw, I was scared to death! I thought Su Lang was looking for a woman outside to have a baby!"
"Well, it doesn't matter if you have a child outside. Brother Su Lang has a very high level of cultivation. It is difficult to have a child."
"Yes, Brother Su Lang's cultivation level has improved so quickly, he must have a baby early."
"Yes, yes, give birth early, even if you are looking for a woman outside, as long as you have a baby."
"I don't know if Brother Su Lang needs our help?"
"I don't know, who knows what he is thinking?"
Two women, one word for you and one for me, crazy suggesting Su Lang.
Su Lang was stunned for a while, and then smiled, "If you want to have a baby, come and me now!"
As soon as this remark came out, Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian suddenly babbled, blushing, and ran away.
"Haha, really just stubbornly."
"Don't dare to do a real fight with me!"
Su Lang laughed, and then flew to the top of the island with his hands behind his back.
Chu Xiaobei was practicing on the top of the mountain.
When he came to Chu Xiaobei, Su Lang took a close look at her state.
At this time, she had taken the Immortal Soul Pill, and a terrifying spiritual storm was shrouded in her body.
If it weren't for Su Lang's mental power had just been upgraded to Huiyue level.
With the spiritual power of the Morningstar level before, staying next to Chu Xiaobei would not last long, and death replacement would be triggered.
To put it simply, it is a warrior who stays beside Chu Xiaobei for a while and will cool off.
This shows how terrifying Chu Xiaobei's mental power is.
Of course, Su Lang didn't think Chu Xiaobei's mental power could break through to the realm of the sun in one fell swoop.
There is a big gap between Wu Shen and Wu Sheng, and the gap between Wu Sheng and Wu Xian is even greater!
It can be said that the chasm between Wu Sheng and Wu Xian is even more terrifying than the gap from the body tempering stage to the realm of Wu Sheng.
Such a huge gap can never be broken by an elixir of Three Tribulations.
Even if it is a higher-level pill, it won't work.
Of course, for Su Lang, if one doesn't work, then two? If two don't work, then I will give you a bowl.
"Digest the pill earlier."
Su Lang looked at Chu Xiaobei with anticipation in his heart.
The strongest accomplice around him right now, bah, is a comrade, Li Xianyang.
But Li Xianyang lost the ability to practice, and could only follow Su Lang's step by step to improve.
Su Lang estimated that if he used the hole card of Swallowing Clone, his true combat power would not necessarily be able to rise to the level of Martial Fairy.
But Chu Xiaobei is different.

Su Lang estimated that if he used the hole card of Swallowing Clone, his true combat power would not necessarily be able to rise to the level of Martial Fairy.
But Chu Xiaobei is different.

chapters.title: Chapter 642: My fairy lady
paragraphs: This girl is an unparalleled qualification, the strongest cultivation qualification Su Lang has ever seen.
Su Lang believes that as long as she manages enough resources, she will definitely break through the moat in a short time and become a martial immortal.
That is the real Wuxian.
At any time, it can maintain the powerful combat power and deterrence capabilities of the Wuxian level.
Unlike Su Lang, he can only be a macho for half an hour.
Well, in fact, half an hour doesn't seem to be too short. Anything longer than half an hour must be bragging.
"My lady fairy, come up quickly!"
Su Lang licked his lips, and immediately refined a bottle of ten Immortal Soul Pills of Three Tribulations and placed it beside Chu Xiaobei.
He had the intention to synthesize it into a higher-level elixir, but was afraid that Beckham could not digest it, so he gave up.
Leaving the elixir, Su Lang left another letter, which said about bringing Xiaohai.
Finish it all.
Su Lang came into the air, and when he was talking to Ruxue Xianxian and refining pill for Xiaobei, there were three more martial arts students.
Su Lang looked at the warriors who had broken through to the martial sage realm, and deliberately brought them back to the sea of sky to participate in guarding.
However, they have just broken through the Martial Saint and need a little time to consolidate the realm of cultivation.
"Just dozens of martial sages are not enough."
"When there are more people breaking through, come and take them away."
Su Lang thought about it, and then left this remote island in the sea.
He did not leave Blue Star directly.
Instead, follow the memory of visiting the Blue Star before and head to a mountain range.
With his true quasi-sage level, the speed is so fast that the sonic boom has dragged hundreds of meters, which can be described as a real cloud and fog.
Not long after, at the destination, an unknown mountain range appeared in front of Su Lang.
Without any hesitation, he plunged his head and came to a bare rock face.
This rock wall appeared very abruptly, and other places were densely vegetation, only it was bare here, like a middle-aged uncle’s Mediterranean Sea.
And the reason why this rock wall is so strange is because there was a strange fire on it!
If you look closely, you can find traces of black and red veins, like irregular spider webs all over the rock wall.
This is a kind of heavenly fire, named Rock Blood Dark Sorrow!
"Go Li Taiqing!"
With a move of Su Lang's heart, he used a trick to immediately ingest the strange fire all over the rock wall into his hands.
The dark blood of rock blood turned into a black-red tent-like flame, constantly struggling, just like a living thing.
However, even though it was a heavenly fire, its damage was only at the martial arts level, and for Su Lang, it was just a hand warmer.
"Ding! Rock blood dark flames are detected, is it refining?"
"Refining!"
Su Lang directly ordered, and the strange fire in his hand disappeared.
The reason why he came here was to refine the different fires.
He wants to know the magic of these different fires, and even the rules of the fire system cannot evolve.
A short while.
"Ding! The Dark Blood Flame has been refined!"
"Is it so fast?
Su Lang was taken aback for a moment, and then he was stunned, "That's right, my real combat power has half stepped into the Martial Saint level."
"Rock Blood Dark Sorrow!"
With a move in Su Lang's heart, a black-red flame suddenly emerged.
These strange fires were not suspended in the air, but attached to Su Lang's body surface, forming black veins all over the body, just like when it was climbing on a rock wall.
"It feels like I have an extra Kill Matt tattoo..."
Su Lang curled his lips, and immediately began to look at the confidence of this kind of heavenly fire.
Rock Blood Dark Sorrow is regarded as an auxiliary type of different fire, which can enhance the power of the host's blood.
The general Wu Zun used it, at least three times the energy and blood of himself, which can be described as extremely abnormal.
But for Su Lang, the effect was minimal.
"Heavenly fire is useless."
Su Lang frowned and revoked the Dark Blood Flame.
Immediately, the black and red veins clinging to Su Lang gradually disappeared.
"If you don't see the strangeness of a different kind of fire, then there are more places."
Su Lang moved his feet straight into the sky and unfolded towards the next destination.
Along the way, he also deployed the spirit power of the Huiyue level to ensure that he would not miss the strange fire he encountered on the way.

chapters.title: Chapter 643: Zhu Qi and his men
paragraphs: at the same time.
Canglan Continent.
Inside an active volcano in the Yaochi saint area.
A huge space was opened up in the boiling magma.
In the space, a tall and thin man is leading a large group of people intently looking at a light curtain of sacred artifacts.
It looks a bit like a group of people watching a movie.
Speaking of the identity of this group of people can scare many people to death, they are the people who kill the sky.
The tall and thin man headed was Zhu Qi, the seventh-in-chief of the Intelligence Department of Tuantian Tower.
And behind him, there are dozens of martial sages sitting, their names are probably Zhu + numbers.
This is just a part of Zhu Qi, the seventh commander in the intelligence department of the Tuantian Tower, and all his Martial Saint-level subordinates are probably one or two hundred.
From this it can be seen that the strength of the Slaughter Tower is really strong.
Look at the scene in the light curtain.
A layer of indigo powder mask occupies the entire light curtain, which is a barrier unfolded by the sea of sky.
In fact, they also want to see something deeper, but their own sacred artifacts simply can't do other people's fairy artifacts, they can only see a thin and silky barrier.
"This is a defensive mask transformed by a real fairy!"
"Aren't they all of quasi-immortal artifacts before? How come they suddenly become immortal artifacts!?"
"Damn it, the original quasi-immortal weapon suddenly became an immortal weapon, and Zhu 108 also died unclearly. This Su Lang is too weird!"

"Our people heard the news and speculated that Zhu 108 died in the hands of the old servant beside Su Lang. The old servant is the ancient Great Sage Immortal Yang Wusheng who has remained to this day, and he worshiped Su Lang as his master as soon as he came out.

In addition, Su Lang refined the quasi-immortal weapon Sky Sea in front of countless people, and now the Sky Sea has suddenly been promoted to the immortal weapon, it is estimated that Su Lang did it. "

"Perhaps, the quasi-immortal artifacts he refined before were only semi-finished products. It takes time to brew before it can gradually transform into a spirit of an immortal weapon and be promoted to an immortal artifact?"

"Perhaps that's the case. I have also seen examples of quasi-immortal artifacts evolving into immortal artifacts over a long period of time. However, in the sea of sky, it is obvious that Su Lang used some magical means, which greatly shortened the time."

"Hey, this can be regarded as a direct refining of immortal artifacts. Su Lang can refine immortal artifacts. This will be regarded as the existence of the sacred guest wherever he goes on the Canglan Continent!"
"Yes, immortal artifacts are several times rarer than martial immortals. Talents who can refine immortal artifacts are afraid that the emperor will give two points of face!"
"Although this person is not of the direct blood of the emperor, I am afraid that he has a lot of background, otherwise the ancient martial sage Li Xianyang would not worship him as the master."
"Hmph, anyway, if this person killed my slaughterer, he must give an explanation."
"Yes, isn't he good at making immortal artifacts? Let's arrest him and let him make immortal artifacts for us at Tuantianlou every day and night."
"Haha, anyway, the immortal forces dare not provoke us, and the imperial clans do not look down on an immortal refiner. As long as we catch him, no one will save him."
"This is a good idea. Many of the Wuxian adults in Tuantianlou don't have fairy tools!"
"This Su Lang must be caught, but this person is too cunning and the defense is so tight, we have to think about it long-term.
"With the value that Su Lang currently shows, it is entirely possible for the Wuxian adults in the organization to take action. Maybe even Zhuxian adults will be interested."
"By the way, what exactly is Master Zhu Xian up to? Why is it always coming and going in a hurry? It always gives me the feeling that wind and rain are coming."
"Master Zhu Xian is something you can guess, be careful, Master Zhu Xian counts, and figure out that you are disrespectful behind your back, hehe!"
"I'm not disrespectful, I haven't said anything..."
Everyone talked about it, and they were shocked by the sudden transformation of the sea of sky into a fairy, and their attitude towards Su Lang also changed.
When they came before, they came with a mentality of killing.
At this time, he became a man who captured him alive and turned him into a tool for making immortal artifacts in the Liantian Tower.
However, it was obvious that they still chose to stand on the opposite side of Su Lang.
And what awaits them will be a tragic end...
Of course, these Slaughter Towers guys didn't know that they had provoke an enemy that was so abnormal that they could not be described.
They were still imagining the wonderful scene where Su Lang was caught and asked him to refine the fairy artifact.
It's exciting to think about it with a sacred artifact!

chapters.title: Chapter 645: Annihilation plan!
paragraphs: And this plan was called the evil immortal by Su Lang, oh bah, it was Jianxian!
The so-called Annihilation Plan, as the name suggests, is a plan to annihilate Wuxian.
The inspiration for this plan came from the Tai Chi meteorite thunder!
When dealing with Wuyang Wusheng, Su Lang had planned to use this one-time weapon to kill Wuyang Wuzun.
But later, because of Chu Xiaobei's shot, Wuyang Wusheng was scared to pee directly, so he didn't use Taiji Meteorite Thunder.
At this time, facing the powerful Slaughter Heaven Tower, Su Lang had already evolved into a terrifying one-time holy weapon.
And this is also Su Lang's other trump card besides Sky Sea.
At this time, the Taiji Meteorite God Thunder has reached the level of high-level sacred artifacts. Once it explodes, the quasi immortal can be killed!
But this is not enough, but there are many powerful organizations of Wuxian in the Slaughter Sky Tower.
A sacred artifact that can kill Quasi-Xiang basically has no deterrent power.
Therefore, Su Lang intends to evolve it into a one-off fairy weapon and become a nuclear bomb in the fantasy world. If one goes down, the martial arts will be destroyed!
Moreover, Su Lang did not intend to make only one, nor did he intend to make only Tai Chi Meteorite Thunder.
He also has to build a cannon, which is the core of the JXian plan, the JXian cannon.
Although only relying on Tai Chi Meteorite God Thunder, it can also blow up the Liantianlou to cry father and mother.
However, the method of using Tai Chi Meteorite Thunder is more complicated. It needs to rely on the death substitution function to "replace life for life".
But as long as the Jixian Cannon was built, there was no need for Su Lang to rush up with an explosive bag in his hand to change his life with the enemy.
Just plug the Tai Chi meteorite thunder into the Jixian Cannon and launch it out to directly kill the enemy.
Of course, the plan is good!
But there are still many difficulties in implementation.
The biggest difficulty facing Su Lang at the moment is the shortage of materials.
The Jixian Artillery was at least a fairy weapon in Su Lang's plan, otherwise it would not be possible to hit Wuxian at all.
According to Su Lang's vision, the Jiexian Artillery must have an intermediate level to ensure the safety of the Yaochi Holy City.
As a result, the building of the Jixian Cannon must consume more materials than refining the sky and sea.
Especially the Soul of Wusheng.
Su Lang doesn't need to think about knowing that Wu Sheng's soul is not enough.
Because the soul of Wusheng is not only used to refine the Jiexian Cannon, but also used to refine the Immortal-level Taiji Meteorite Thunder!
Otherwise, the cannons are powerful, but the shells are not powerful. There is an egg.
Regarding this huge difficulty, Su Lang's current method is to use war to support war.
First, finish refining the various parts of the Jixian Cannon, and when the battle begins, kill the opponent's Martial Saint, and then quickly evolve the Jixian Cannon!
But before that, it was a very dangerous gap period. If there is a Wuxian, you need to pounce on Su Lang with an explosive bag and die with the enemy.
"I hope the other party will not send Wuxian from the beginning."
"It would be great if you send Wu Sheng to send some materials first."
Su Lang thought, with a smile on his face, "I don't want that much. Soldiers are here to cover up the water and earth. Now carry out the first step of the plan, the exchange system."
The exchange system is a great tool for Su Lang to collect materials.
Although the basic materials are sufficient for the time being, just in case, it is necessary to establish an exchange system among the three races.
This will not only earn more materials and spirit jade, but also increase prestige and unite people.
Thinking of this, Su Lang immediately summoned Yaochi Yan Fa and other martial sages from the sea of sky.
"Master!"
Yaochi Yan Fa and other Wu Sheng respectfully salute.
"I have an exchange system here that you need to establish."
Su Lang said, "The so-called exchange system is a system that allows warriors to exchange low-level materials for high-level materials. The exchange ratio is very friendly.
Specifically, I will let Huangfuqin tell you, oh, Huangfuqin is my first soul-heart servant.
Huangfuqin has established an exchange system in my own clan and has rich experience. You follow his orders..."

paragraphs: As soon as this remark came out, Yaochi Yan Fa and others were surprised and surprised.

However, they knew that the reason why Su Lang did this must have his own intentions. They only need to execute the order.

Everyone knelt down to take orders.
Soon, Su Lang took a trip and took Huangfuqin from Lanxing to the holy city of Yaochi.

At this moment, Su Lang not only wanted to take him to the holy city, but also let him take on the important task of establishing the exchange system of the three holy races!
In the sea hall of the sky.

"Yao Chi Yan Fa."
"Next, you will listen to Huangfuqin's arrangement."

This matter is extremely important. It is related to our war with Tutianlou. You must make it beautiful. "

Yaochi Yan Fa and others knelt down to lead the order.
Huangfuqin prostrated with excitement, "Lord, if I make a mistake at this time, I would like to apologize with death!"
"OK."
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, and he waved his hand, "Let's do everything now!"
"Yes!!"
Everyone left and went to establish an exchange system.
"The population of the three holy races is many times larger than that of the Wind Spirit Race and the Human Race combined."
"It is estimated that my various functions will be overloaded, and I can only raise the threshold of the exchange system."
"This time, raise the threshold of the exchange system to the Wu Zun level."
After some consideration, Su Lang sent the message to Huangfuqin.

Next.
Su Lang left a clone to play with Xiao Hai, and his deity returned to the blue star.

And the first batch of twenty martial artists who broke through to the martial sage realm have consolidated their realm, are continuing to comprehend the rules, and are moving towards a higher level.

"Master!"
"We have broken through to the realm of Martial Saint!"
"Thank the lord for giving me the pill, thank the lord for giving me a treasure for cultivation!"
"I wait for eternal life and never forget the Lord's great grace!"
All the martial sages stepped forward and knelt on the ground instantly.
"Okay, get up all!"
"As long as you are effective, there will be more generous rewards in the future!"
Su Lang smiled faintly, "What is the realm of Martial Saint, I will give you the elixir in the future, so that you can expect Martial Immortal!"
After hearing this, everyone was moved to tears.
"Next, I have one thing for you to do."
Su Lang said, "The Sea of Sky has been promoted to an immortal weapon by me. At the moment, your patriarch has other important things, so you need to guard the Sea of Sky."
"The Sea of Sky has been promoted to a fairy tool!!"
"The Lord is so powerful, even the fairy can be made out."

Everyone kowtowed to show their loyalty and determination.

paragraphs: "well."
"Next you follow me back to the holy city of Yaochi."

"The range of the sea of sky covers the range of dozens of Yaochi holy cities."
"I have a chance to guard such a great fairy!"
The martial sages hovered in the air, looking at the sea of sky that had evolved into a fairy, and they kept admiring them.
And at this moment.
"Ma Ma Ma Ma~"
A tender yell came, and all the martial sages looked around, only to see a dumpling with the face of the owner flying over.
"What a miraculous creature, is this?"
"It should be the spirit of the fairy, and the fairy has the spirit!
"This is the spirit of the fairy, but why does it call the Lord Ma Ma?"
Everyone looked at Xiao Hai in surprise and curiosity.
"You are right."
Su Lang stretched out his hand and screwed Xiao Hai in front of him, "It is the spirit of the sea of the sky. It is very simple at this time. Don't teach it badly, otherwise I can't spare you."

"okay."

"Yes!"
All the martial sages took their orders one after another, and immediately entered the sea of sky to guard.
When they were in the realm of quasi-sage, they guarded the sea of sky, so they were familiar with the road.
Twenty martial sages guarded the Sea of Sky, and the power suddenly increased a lot.
"The sea of the sky is divided into twelve sacred objects and twelve bridges, using a total of 3,032 parts."
"I don't know how far the sea of sky can reach when every part is guarded by Wu Sheng. I really look forward to it."
While thinking about it, Su Lang played with the little sea like dumplings, causing it to keep calling ‘Ma Ma Ma Ma~’
"You, everything is fine, just like barking, but I can't change it..."
Su Lang rolled his eyes helplessly, and immediately moved, using his clone to replace him in a remote area in the Yaochi area.
Randomly found a place to sit down, and he took out the Tai Chi Meteor Thunder God from the storage space.
At this time, the Taiji Meteorite God Thunder has been evolved into a high-level holy artifact by Su Lang.
From the beginning, its body has grown larger and smaller, and now it has become only the size of a basketball.
But the breath radiating from his body became more and more dangerous.
It feels that even if you rub him, it will explode immediately.
Ordinary Wu Sheng would never dare to approach this meteor thunder at will, let alone hold it in his hand like Su Lang.
The reason why Su Lang came to this remote area was to prevent the Tai Chi Meteorite Thunder from accidentally exploding in the city.
Looking at the Tai Chi Meteorite Thunder in his hand, Su Lang hesitated and ordered: "System, decompose Tai Chi Meteorite Thunder!"

"Ding! Decompose the high-level sage soldier Tai Chi Meteorite Thunder*1, and you will get the Soul of Valkyrie*8, Tai Chi Heavenly Fire Jade*200, Kuang Lei Sacred Heart*300, Rainstorm Tiansha*240, Canghai Colorful Stone*500... ..."
In a blink of an eye, Tai Chi Meteorite Thunder became a pile of materials.
The reason why this Taiji Meteorite God Thunder was decomposed was because this God Thunder had evolved many times, and Su Lang no longer remembered what material it was refined from.
Decomposing it, its refining is convenient and clear at a glance, you can directly refining the holy rank divine thunder, without starting to evolve from the noble rank.
"The material consumed is really enough."
"Slightly low-level materials are all three-digit numbers!"
"Fortunately, I got the resources of the three saints, otherwise it would be difficult to refine one."
After some emotions, Su Lang refined the decomposed divine thunder again, and ordered: "The system, only retains the characteristics of the'disposable weapon', and evolves it into a fairy weapon!"

"Ding! Consumes the soul of the martial god*2, the soul of the of war*8, the sacred thunder jade of the two poles*6, the purple thunder tree of the heavens*10...the Taiji meteorite thunder has evolved into a primary fairy weapon!"

chapters.title: Chapter 648: Refining Jixian Cannon
paragraphs: After the system prompts, the Tai Chi meteorite thunder evolves successfully.
Su Lang took it out of the storage space, and a frightening aura immediately spread.
The creatures within hundreds of thousands of miles instantly felt a crisis coming, as if they could lose their lives at any time.
Whether it is the Beast Emperor, the Beast Sovereign, or even the God-level Fierce Beast, it is also shivering.
Countless creatures were frightened and wailed constantly, fleeing around like headless flies, and some were limp on the spot, with feces and urine flowing.
Su Lang, who holds the God Thunder in his hand, is also frightened.
He observed carefully and found that the Tai Chi Meteorite Thunder had become only the size of an ostrich egg.
Its surface was covered with things like dense scales, and a crimson light faintly revealed in the gaps between the scales.
Su Lang wrapped it with mental power, carefully guessed its power, and soon recovered his mental power.
The primary fairy weapon level Tai Chi Meteor Thunder God!
Once this thing bursts open, at least a million li will be turned into ashes, and it is estimated that the Four Tribulations will be seriously injured! !
The earth will be penetrated, I don’t know how deep it is!
"This is the power of a fairy-level disposable weapon!"
Su Lang took a deep breath, his eyes revealed excitement, "It's even more terrifying than even more advanced fairy tools."
"The only drawback is that it consumes too much material."
"Besides, this thing doesn't seem to be smart?"
Su Lang made another observation with some curiosity, only to find an aura.
And this aura is not strong, not as good as the aura of Youtian Sword.
"It's okay if you don't have a tool.
Su Lang smiled dumbly, "If another artifact appears to call me Baba, I can't let it explode."
After getting the new Taiji Meteorite Thunder thoroughly, Su Lang refined two again and put them in the storage space together.
At this point, there is only one copy of Wu Sheng Soul.
There are a lot of Valkyrie Souls!
It just so happened that what Su Lang was going to do next only needed the Soul of Valkyrie for the time being.
"Next, let's start refining the parts of the JXian Cannon."
Su Lang took a deep breath, took out a large amount of materials from the storage space, and began to refine the parts of the JXian Cannon.
The design principle of the JXian Cannon is similar to that of the Sky Sea, and both use low-level parts to form high-end products.
Of course, the so-called ‘low-level parts’ are at least god-level!
It is a rare artifact in the ordinary small race!
Moreover, this time with the experience of refining the sea of sky, Su Lang intends to refine a larger-scale fairy tool!
There are as many as six thousand six hundred and sixty-six kinds of parts alone, which is more than twice that of the sky and sea.
Among them, there are a total of sixty-six kinds of holy order parts as the core.
Because the JXian Cannon is almost ‘customized’, it’s more difficult to refine than the sky and sea.
Almost every part requires Su Lang to participate in the refining.
Fortunately, the system can also help in many ways.
Because Su Lang's own refining skills were so superb that he could refine the imperial soldiers.
So in many cases, it is almost impossible to guess what kind of things can be refined with which materials.
These things that can be guessed can be handed over to the system for refining.
Even if there is a slight error in the refining of the system, Su Lang can modify it.
Modification, of course, is much faster than refining from scratch.
In addition, many of the over 6,000 parts are duplicates.
Su Lang first refines one piece, then decomposes it to obtain the formula, and then lets the system refine it.
There are a small number of parts that directly use the sky and sea, so they can also be refined directly.
In this way, a lot of time is saved!
Su Lang estimated that the time needed to refine the Jixian Cannon was shorter than that of the Sky Sea.
Just when Su Lang was frantically refining JXian Cannon parts.
In a remote place, in the huge waterfall, in a secret room, Zhu Qi and other intelligence personnel were having a meeting.
Zhu Qi did not sit at the head because someone was sitting in that position.
Zhu Liu, a martial arts immortal in a robbery, this man is tall, solemn, with sharp eyes like a knife, and a air of horror is exuding all over his body.
I don't know how many people Zhu Liu killed.

In addition, many of the over 6,000 parts are duplicates.
Su Lang first refines one piece, then decomposes it to obtain the formula, and then lets the system refine it.
There are a small number of parts that directly use the sky and sea, so they can also be refined directly.
In this way, a lot of time is saved!
Su Lang estimated that the time needed to refine the Jixian Cannon was shorter than that of the Sky Sea.
Just when Su Lang was frantically refining JXian Cannon parts.
In a remote place, in the huge waterfall, in a secret room, Zhu Qi and other intelligence personnel were having a meeting.
Zhu Qi did not sit at the head because someone was sitting in that position.
Zhu Liu, a martial arts immortal in a robbery, this man is tall, solemn, with sharp eyes like a knife, and a air of horror is exuding all over his body.
I don't know how many people Zhu Liu killed.

chapters.title: Chapter 649: Zhu Liu
paragraphs: "Are you sure that Su Lang can refine fairy artifacts?"
Zhu Liu's eyes flickered, and his cold voice was faintly waved.
It has been more than 10,000 years since he broke through to Wuxian, but he still uses this high-level holy artifact.
He has seen fairy tools or something, but he has never touched it.
Knowing that there is a mysterious little guy who can make immortal artifacts, he immediately became interested!
"Return to the Six Great Masters, we are sure that Su Lang can refine immortal artifacts."
"Our people watched the quasi-immortal artifact evolve into an immortal artifact!"
Zhu Qi looked respectful. Although he was the seventh in command, the Tuantian Tower organization was very strict, and Zhu Liu could only do so if he asked him to die.
"Even if it is not directly refined, but with special means, it is very valuable."
"Although this Su Lang killed the quasi immortal and martial sage of our organization, this is not an unsolvable enmity."
"You are ready to come to your door to apologize, turn the fighting into a jade silk, and then invite him to our Tuantian Tower."
With a smile on Zhu Liu's face, he seemed to look forward to meeting Su Lang.
As for the dead Cai Liao and others, in his eyes they are no different from the ants, and they are not worth mentioning.
Zhu Qi asked, "Six Masters, if Su Lang refuses to agree, what should I do?"
"Unwilling to agree?"
"Haha, I want to see him in Slaughter Tower, dare he agree?"
Zhu Liu sneered, "If he toasts and doesn't eat or drink fine wine, I will come to meet him personally."
"Big Six.
"Su Lang now has the guardian of the fairy!"
Zhu Qi said: "There is also a great sage of Xianyang beside him. He is quite famous in the ancient times, and he may have broken through to the realm of Wuxian..."
"Ha ha!"
"It's just a fairy weapon that has just been promoted. Can you stop me?"
"And that Xianyang Martial Sage, an old thing from the ancient times, a waste of life that hasn't broken through to the realm of Wuxian in vain, is eligible to be compared with me?"
Zhu Liu's face sneered even more, even showing a trace of killing intent.
"My lord is forgiving, because the subordinates talk too much!"
Seeing this, Zhu Qi immediately knelt down and begged for mercy, a lot of sweat drenched on his forehead.
A cold sweat, this is also very rare for him as a quasi immortal.
"Huh! Don't do it yet!?"
Zhu Liu stood up, with his hands on his back, a murderous intent surging out like a river of blood!
"Yes!!"
Zhu Qi and others knelt down to take orders, immediately retreated, left the secret room, and set off for the Yaochi Saint Clan.
"The fairy..."
Zhu Liu whispered, his eyes full of coveting.
Time to shuttle.
In a blink of an eye, one day passed.
Su Lang is still refining JXian Cannon parts non-stop. At this point he has completed half of the parts.
And just as he took out a god-level part that had just been refined from the cauldron, one after another system prompted the front heel to rang with the back foot.
"Ding! The water system rules have been understood, do you accept it?"
"Ding! "Chongxu Mingjian Tu" has reached the founding level!"
"Ding! "The Wushou Divine Body Jue" has reached the founding level!"
"Ding! "Nine Color Jade Cicada Sutra" has reached the founding level!"
"Ding! "Shen Luo Wanxiang Jue" has reached the founding level!"
"Ding! "The Secret Technique of Extinguishing the Sky" has reached the founding level!"
"I'll go, so coincidental, understand the rules and the exercises at the same time?"
Su Lang felt that he had mastered five god-level exercises, his body strength and spiritual energy reserves had increased a lot, he couldn't help but raised his brows and smiled.
In addition, "Chongxu Mingjian Tu" also brought his kendo attainments to a higher level.
As for "Sen Luo Wanxiang Jue" and "Secret Method of Extinguishing the Sky with Blood Flame", both are secret techniques. If they are not activated, they will not work.
"Sin Luo Wanxiang!"
With a thought of Su Lang, he used the Sen Luo Wanxiang Art.
The breath on his body immediately began to change, and his body shape and appearance have also undergone tremendous changes.
In an instant, Su Lang completely changed his appearance.
"With my current strength."
"No ordinary martial artist can see through my disguise, this technique is still very good."
Su Lang nodded in satisfaction, and immediately revoked the exercise and restored it to its original state.

chapters.title: Chapter 650: Practice the holy order!
paragraphs: "The Secret Method of Extinguishing the Sky" Su Lang did not try.
This method does not hurt the enemy first, it hurts yourself first, and it would be stupid to try for no reason.
What's more, even if he didn't try, Su Lang could roughly feel how much combat power this technique could enhance himself.
Don't need to swallow the clone, using this technique can probably make him enter the martial arts level in all aspects.
If the swallowing clone is used, it can roughly increase the level of Wu Sheng by half a small realm.
But if you reach the level of Wuxian, you can't improve much.
Of course, it is a good thing to be able to improve, the war between warriors, the slightest difference is the key to victory!
Next.
Su Lang chose to accept the water system rules.
"Ding! Water system rules have been issued!"
After being prompted by the system, Su Langdun gave an enlightenment and instantly mastered the rules of the water system.
In an instant, countless water droplets were formed around him. These water droplets vary in size, but they are all very mellow and crystallized, just like the treasure in the world!
When Su Lang thought, countless water droplets merged to form a slender stream.
This water flow circulates around Su Lang like a living thing.

At first glance, the water flow is completely incomparable to the explosiveness of the fire and thunder rules, but in fact it carries a soft and attrition force. Once it is entangled, the consequences may be more than that of the fire thunder rules. It's more painful to hit.
Water system rules can erode and wear away, and their power cannot be underestimated.
It also moisturizes the warrior itself, has the function of increasing aura reserves, and has a certain beauty effect.
In addition, there are various magical effects, which are not enough to sum up.
"Scatter!"
Su Lang thought, the rules of the water system dissipated, and the water flow was also annihilated.
Immediately after.
Su Lang began to choose the exercises to practice next.
"At present, my strength has already entered Wu Sheng with half a foot."
"Although the god-level exercises are still useful, they have gradually lost their stamina. Let's start practicing the holy-level exercises this time."
After thinking about it for a while, Su Lang began to choose a holy level technique.
Although he has not many holy level skills at present, it is not too small.
The first is the synthesized "Water Martian Elephant Sacred Scroll", which Li Xianyang has commented on, it is very advanced even in the holy order.

Secondly, it is the "Nine Stars Purple Rainbow Fantasy Book" from Yanxingxing, and the "Sacred Record of the True Sky of Yaochi", "The True Secret of the Red Sun and Ten Thousand Miles" and "The Secret Book of Tianyun Asking the Tao" from the three saints.
Again, there are "Black Flame True Sage Xuanshu", "Longevity Cloud Heart Treasure Scroll", and "Water Mirror Thousand Red True Book" from Wuyang Wusheng, Cai Liao and others.
In addition, it is obtained from Li Xianyang's "Secret of Soul Seed Heart", "Tian Cicada Jade Gu Jue", "Zhenji Wenyuan Secret Book" and so on.
Su Lang also owns several immortal exercises, such as "The True Jue of the Nine Revolving Immortal Sun", "Praying for Immortals", and "Sacred Code of Reincarnation Immortal Eyes".

If the exercises practiced by Chu Xiaobei are counted, then the immortal-level exercises "Ice Jade Fairy Yuan Zhenlu", the holy-level exercises "Bodhi Worshiping the Moon Profound Art", "Yuqing Nine Imperial Forbidden Techniques" .
Counting it down, Su Lang possessed ten holy-level exercises. Except for the "Sacred Scroll of Water and Mars," they were all non-synthetic "natural exercises.
"With only one holy rank technique, you can synthesize a fairy rank technique!"
There was a trace of excitement on Su Lang's face. Immortal level cultivation technique, this is the foundation of a great immortal clan.
In terms of its value, a fairy-level exercise method is more valuable than a fairy weapon!
Su Lang estimated that if an immortal level exercise was auctioned, then the immortal clan would do their best to bid.
"Biyu must have a holy-level technique."
"When things are done here, I will go to subdue the Biyu clan."
While thinking about it, Su Lang selected five of the holy level exercises he currently possessed.
They are "Water and Mars Elephant Sacred Scroll", "Nine Star Purple Rainbow Fantasy Book", "Black Flame True Sage Book", "Water Mirror Thousand Red True Book", and "Secret of Soul Seed Heart".
"Ding! The exercise is successfully placed, and it has started to practice automatically!"
After Su Lang placed the Wuben exercises, a system prompt came, and the five martial arts villains immediately began to practice the exercises.
"System, how long does it take to practice these five holy-level exercises to the founding level?" Su Lang asked aloud.
"Ding! Host, it only takes twelve days to reach the founding level!"
"Twelve days, it's almost as I expected."
Su Lang nodded slightly, and immediately put aside the exercises, and continued to refine the JXian Cannon parts.
